LLM Memory Hyperdimensional Computing MCP CLI

SQAC — Symbolic Query Addressable Cartridge

Portable, file-based LLM memory on hyperdimensional computing (HDC/VSA). One .sqac file. Any LLM. Facts and skills that persist, survive restarts, and swap in milliseconds — no retraining, no database, no GPU.
